name: Consumer product recalls by year and hazard (CPSC recall notices)
description: Recalls announced by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) since 2010, counted for the whole period, for each recall year and for each of ten hazard classes (fire and burn, falls and tip-overs, laceration, choking and suffocation, ingestion, entrapment and pinch injuries, electric shock, poisoning and chemicals, crashes and collisions, drowning, plus a class for the rest). Each count comes with the number of recalls whose notice reports an injury and the number that report a death, parsed from the notice's own incident text, and with the units the notices give. A recall that names several hazards counts once in each class and once in the totals. The counts come from CPSC's recall API; no firm names, contacts or narratives are kept.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Consumer product recalls by year and hazard (CPSC recall notices) (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116056
keywords: Consumer Product Safety Commission recall counts

distribution.name: product-recalls.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: product-recalls.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: product-recalls-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in product-recalls-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to product-recalls.csv on id.

recordSet.name: product-recalls
recordSet.description: The records of Consumer product recalls by year and hazard (CPSC recall notices), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: US (every record is national)

field.name: level
field.description: us (the whole period), year (one recall year) or hazard (one hazard class)

field.name: yearsFrom
field.description: First recall year kept

field.name: yearsTo
field.description: Last recall year kept (the current year is partial)

field.name: dataThrough
field.description: Date of the latest recall announcement read

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Same as recalls

field.name: unit
field.description: What the value counts

field.name: recalls
field.description: Recalls CPSC announced (one per recall notice)

field.name: injury_recalls
field.description: Recalls whose notice reports at least one injury (parsed from the notice's incident text; a lower bound, because a notice may describe harm in words the parser does not read as an injury)

field.name: death_recalls
field.description: Recalls whose notice reports at least one death (parsed from the notice's incident text)

field.name: units_parsed
field.description: Units the notices give, summed over the recalls that state a number (parsed; the notices usually round them)

field.name: units_recalls
field.description: Recalls that state a unit count

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the first recall year kept

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Date of the latest recall announcement read

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
